documents.title: Queue delivery
documents.body: A failed delivery enters the retry queue. Exponential backoff limits repeated requests. Idempotency prevents duplicate jobs.

documents.title: Retry policy
documents.body: Retry failed requests after a bounded delay. A queue worker may try three times before parking the job.

documents.title: Carbon measurement
documents.body: The badge displays estimated carbon emissions from transferred bytes. Its estimate is not a certificate.

documents.title: Badge rendering
documents.body: Embed the carbon badge in a page footer. Keep its label accessible to screen readers.

documents.title: Database maintenance
documents.body: Before a schema migration, take a SQLite backup. Restore it into an isolated directory and check integrity.

documents.title: Storage recovery
documents.body: A backup needs a tested restore procedure. Retain the previous database until verification finishes.

documents.title: Approval integrity
documents.body: A signature binds an approval to reviewed bytes. Trusted identity must be established separately. A content hash alone does not identify a reviewer.

documents.title: Reviewer identity
documents.body: Validate reviewer identity before accepting an approval. Review the authorization policy separately from the document hash.

documents.title: Łódź

documents.title: Cat
documents.body: The cat sleeps beside the window.

documents.title: Catalogue
documents.body: A catalogue lists available templates and their descriptions.

documents.title: Access control
documents.body: Access control enforces caller permissions. A sensitivity label alone does not authorize access.
